regime_context: The China A-share detector shows a narrowing eligible set (9 of 22 themes), with AI Compute & Optics and Gold Miners in a near-tie for leadership (margin 0.023) and no one-narrative dominance. The headline theme (cn_ai_compute) carries a mean-revert hurst tag and low breadth (0.235), while the backtest verdict is explicit that the absolute-trend gate did not hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false) and momentum rank-IC is ~0 — so this is a focus lens, not an edge. Given a prior 46-call track record with only 0.326 directional accuracy, conviction is capped low across the board and a no-view bias is appropriate.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff from AI Compute & Optics: the margin between rank-1 AI Compute and rank-2 Gold Miners is only 0.023, so a durable swap in rank order (Gold Miners holding rank-1 for 5 consecutive sessions) would retire the AI-Compute-leadership read.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: The headline theme is eligible and rank-1, but the trend discipline did not add drawdown control on this market's history (gate_helps=false) and the theme itself carries a mean-revert tag plus very low breadth (0.235), meaning the leadership may be a narrow handful of names rather than a coherent move. The crowding flag is not triggered, but that is not a green light given 0.326 track-record directional accuracy. Avoiding is a disciplined non-call: trend-following logic on a mean-reverting tape has historically whipsawed.
theses.dissent: AI Compute & Optics is the strongest-scoring eligible theme and may continue to attract flow in an attention-driven tape; avoiding it risks missing the one place leadership is concentrating.

falsifier.text: AI Compute & Optics proxy (515000.SS) gains 8% relative to CSI 300 within 20 trading days without a corresponding lift in breadth above 0.4

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the challenger with the strongest durability leg in the top tier (durability_bar 0.93, hurst_tag trend, breadth 1.0) and is essentially tied with the leader. It is unscorable (no ETF proxy), which caps conviction, but the durability/trend-health leg is the one coincident signal with a coherent tape here — full breadth and clear trend support a modest directional lean. This is a judgement expressed as a conditional, not a momentum-rank buy.
evidence: durability_bar: 0.93 (highest in ranks), hurst_tag: trend, breadth: 1.0
crowding_z 0.87, crowded false (size-down caution only, not a fade)
theses.dissent: Unscorable and near a crowded state; the theme is a coincident concentration of leadership, not a validated return edge, and the gate did not help here, so any overweight is experimental.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners theme leadership unwinds such that it slips below rank 3 in the detector within 30 trading days

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Crowded (crowding_z 1.34, crowded true) per the detector, which is a size-down caution — not a fade and not a sell — but combined with 0.326 track-record accuracy and no basket-drawdown edge from crowding, the accountable stance is to avoid adding exposure here rather than treat the flag as actionable direction.
theses.dissent: Crowding alone has no forward edge and is explicitly a cap-not-fade signal; avoiding may leave a genuinely trending healthcare theme un-harvested.
